content: Cache behavior: profiles re-downloaded on every tool run (not cached); version jar files are cached for reuse (source: README.md@b042fcd, harvested 2026-07-23)
Default Minecraft version manifest: %appdata%\.minecraft\versions\version_manifest_v2.json; overridable with make -f flag (source: README.md@b042fcd, harvested 2026-07-23)
Log4J vulnerability fix: writes include.txt next to server jar; may create log4j2_112-116.xml or log4j2_7-112.xml for affected versions (source: README.md@b042fcd, harvested 2026-07-23)
Profiles are JSON files with date-based version schedules; loadable from URLs to enable community sharing without manual coordination (source: README.md@b042fcd, harvested 2026-07-23)

.NET Windows CLI tool with four main commands: update (set client/server to version), make (generate profiles), cache (manage downloads), bake (embed profile in executable) (source: README.md@b042fcd, harvested 2026-07-23)

MinecraftThroughTime (smol-kitten, C#/.NET8 CLI, cloned /home/claude): audit 2026-07-11 fixed via PR#15 — path traversal in CDL.cs URL->cache-path (now CachePath() strips ../rooted + confines to cacheDir), Log4J fix for 1.7-1.11.2 was a silent no-op (arg log4j2_17-111.xml vs downloaded log4j2_7-112.xml, now matched), off-by-one crash Entries[index+1] on last profile entry (both override paths), non-http(s) URL reject. FOLLOW-UPS still open: verify jar downloads vs Mojang manifest SHA1 (GetSha1 unused), widen Log4J version coverage to point releases (1.14.4/1.15.2/etc), add test project. No local dotnet — rely on CI dotnet.yml.
